chapters.title: I build with agents
chapters.lede: I am 23 and I study management at IIM Ranchi, in Ranchi. This page shows how a management student ended up running a team of AI agents.

chapters.title: Start here: what you can use today
chapters.lede: I am a management student who learned to code. I built a small team of AI agents that cannot act without my approval, then used that team to ship apps for other students.

chapters.title: Where I started
chapters.lede: A management degree, a programming diploma and three internships.

chapters.title: Learning the models first
chapters.lede: Modelling projects and competitions came before any agent was allowed to act.

chapters.title: One assistant became {agents_word}
chapters.lede: Today the team is {agents_word} agents. Sends, deletes and public pushes wait for my approval.

chapters.title: What the agents actually do
chapters.lede: A voice note becomes a finished task. Risky steps wait for me.

chapters.title: Why you can trust the agents
chapters.lede: Agents handle sensitive work. Layers of checks keep it from leaking or running unsupervised.

chapters.title: How the products are built
chapters.lede: A closer look at Termly and CogPrep Arcade: the features, the code and the tools behind them.

chapters.title: Going deeper
chapters.lede: Six case studies show the architecture. The code stays private.

chapters.title: What I believe and where I am going
chapters.lede: Four rules I work by. Email me if they fit.
